description: Custom instructions to accelerate CRC-64-ECMA, CRC-16, and CRC-32 by processing 32 bytes at a time, fitting within the 16-word coprocessor operand buffer limit.

instructions.name: CRC-64-ECMA 32-byte step
instructions.semantics: Reads a 64-bit CRC state and 32 bytes of data from a memory block addressed by `rs1`. Computes the updated CRC-64-ECMA value and writes the 64-bit result to the memory block addressed by `rs2`. `rd` receives 0. The input block `in` contains 10 words: `in[0]` (low 32 bits of CRC), `in[1]` (high 32 bits of CRC), and `in[2..9]` (32 bytes of data). The output block `out` is 10 words: `out[0]` (low 32 bits of new CRC), `out[1]` (high 32 bits of new CRC), with `out[2..9]` zero-padded.

instructions.name: CRC-16 32-byte step
instructions.semantics: Reads a 16-bit CRC state and 32 bytes of data from memory addressed by `rs1`. Computes the updated CRC-16 value and writes it to memory addressed by `rs2`. `rd` receives 0. `in[0]` contains the zero-extended CRC state. `in[1..8]` contains 32 bytes of data. `out[0]` contains the updated CRC-16 (zero-extended). `out[1..8]` are zero-padded. Total words is 9.

instructions.name: CRC-32 32-byte step
instructions.semantics: Reads a 32-bit CRC state and 32 bytes of data from memory addressed by `rs1`. Computes the updated CRC-32 value and writes it to memory addressed by `rs2`. `rd` receives 0. `in[0]` contains the CRC state. `in[1..8]` contains 32 bytes of data. `out[0]` contains the updated CRC-32. `out[1..8]` are zero-padded. Total words is 9.

name: CRC Accelerators
tests: link1: coverage 99.92% >= 80%; 3/3 C models built and survived 100,000 vectors under ASan+UBSan
gate2: 3/3 instructions: C model and patched Spike agree on 100,000 random + corner vectors
